scope: Local prospective amendment recorded before any new final confirmation and before running the additional development screen.
selection: For each treatment/native-budget/teacher/architecture, examine checkpoints in ascending update order; require all five seeds perfect on the expanded 300-case development suite; freeze first common perfect checkpoint. Preserve all failed screens. No final rows enter screening or training.
reason: Sixty cases per policy have limited ability to reveal rare failures; use more development before the once-only independent 1000-case final.
unchanged: Training banks, weights, update curves, final graph/tape namespace, final 1000 cases and strict five-seed gate.
resource_concurrency: Two bounded queues may overlap at three one-thread CPU workers each (six workers maximum, of 16 logical CPUs); the resource snapshot retained at launch had 16 GiB available RAM. No external training processes were observed.
